commitResults.messageTitle: feat: centralize exception handling in Friday
commitResults.messageBody:
- Updated parseInput to normalize commands (case-insensitive)
  and delegate execution to specific handlers (Todo, Deadline,
  Event, Mark/Unmark).

- Introduced FridayException and subclasses:
  EmptyDescriptionException, InvalidFormatException,
  UnknownCommandException to standardize error handling.

- Handlers now throw exceptions instead of printing errors
  directly, making behavior consistent across all commands.

- Added createAndAddTask helper to remove duplicate code
  when adding tasks and printing task-added confirmation.
